declaration.preface: Speedrack Products Group Ltd. is committed to responsible purchasing that prioritizes sustainability, ethical conduct, product quality, health & safety, and long-term business resilience. This Sustainable Procurement Policy defines clear ESG-based expectations for all suppliers, contractors, and business partners to ensure that all procured materials, services, and equipment support Speedrack’s environmental, social, and governance objectives.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this policy is to:

Formalize Speedrack’s commitment to environmental stewardship, ethical business conduct, responsible sourcing, and fair labor conditions throughout the supply chain.

Set criteria and performance requirements for supplier selection, evaluation, auditing, and ongoing collaboration.

Ensure that procurement decisions consider full lifecycle impacts, safety, durability, resource efficiency, recyclability, and environmental legislation.

Mitigate operational, legal, environmental, and reputational risks associated with supplier activities.

Promote long-term partnerships focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Speedrack locations, business units, suppliers, and employees involved in procurement activities. It covers all purchases of materials, products, and services, and applies to all suppliers, contractors, and partners engaged in Speedrack’s supply chain.

Environmental Responsibility: Speedrack prioritizes environmentally certified like EMAS, ISO 14001 and other suppliers as a core criterion within its supplier pre-qualification and onboarding framework.
We aim to promote local sourcing as a key climate-mitigation strategy to minimize transportation-related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions across its supply chain.
Circular economy principles are embedded across supplier operations, covering recycling, waste minimization, and material reuse.
Suppliers are consistently encouraged and supported to transition toward renewable and clean energy sources for both operations and logistics.
Speedrack aims to source from suppliers that use eco-friendly, recyclable, and biodegradable packaging wherever feasible.
Ethical Supply Chain & Human Rights: We aim to embed labor and human rights certifications as a key requirement in its supplier pre-qualification and risk screening process.
Certifications such as ISO 45001, SA 8000, and equivalent social compliance standards are recognized as preferred indicators of responsible labor practices.
Company aims to prioritize local suppliers to promote regional development, support community livelihoods, and reduce supply chain emissions.
Supplier diversity is actively promoted through a formal supplier inclusion program for underrepresented and minority-owned businesses.

Transparency & Traceability: Speedrack maintains continuous, structured engagement with suppliers to strengthen collaboration on sustainability performance and ethical sourcing.
A comprehensive supplier sustainability assessment framework, covering environmental, social, and governance parameters, is fully integrated into procurement operations.
Sustainability is systematically embedded into all procurement categories through clearly defined product-specific sustainability criteria.
We aim to provide Code of Conduct including the ESG clauses to all suppliers.

targets.target: We aim to ensure that 100% of suppliers read, acknowledge, and formally agree to the Supplier Code of Conduct
We aim to assess at least 10% of its suppliers annually on sustainability performance.
Speedrack commits to integrating sustainability criteria into 100% of procurement decisions
The company strives to ensure quarterly sustainability performance reporting for 50% of key suppliers
Speedrack aims to train at least 80% of procurement staff on environmental procurement risks and impacts
The company targets a 5% reduction in total supply chain carbon emissions
We plan to ensure that at least 15% of total procurement value is sourced from suppliers holding ISO 14001, EMAS, or equivalent certifications

quantitative.area: Labor Practices and Human Rights Compliance

targets.target: We strive to increase procurement from socially and labor-certified suppliers by 10%
We aim to increase local sourcing by at least 10% to support regional economic development and improve livelihoods in surrounding communities.
We plan to train at least 80% of procurement staff on labor and human rights risks
The company commits to resolving 100% of substantiated supply chain grievances within defined timelines

responsibilities.duty: Review Policy annually & oversee adherence to the Sustainable Procurement Policy.

Review supplier performance metrics and ensure alignment with corporate ESG objectives.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory and industry requirements.
Manage supplier selection, onboarding, and ongoing evaluation.
Integrate environmental, social, and quality standards into contracts and procurement processes.
Monitor supplier compliance with sustainability and ethical requirements.
Conduct periodic audits, inspections, and assessments of suppliers.
Verify adherence to safety, environmental, and quality standards.
Provide technical guidance on environmental and safety requirements.
Comply with the Sustainable Procurement Policy and Supplier Code of Conduct.

policy.monitoring:
Speedrack will maintain transparent internal reporting mechanisms to track:

Supplier sustainability performance and compliance history

Audit results and corrective actions

Supplier risk ratings and improvement plans

Supplier and internal procurement performance will be regularly reviewed through audits, feedback, and external evaluations to ensure compliance with sustainability and ethical standards. Training, awareness initiatives, and digital tools will support responsible sourcing and supplier engagement. Collaboration with employees and partners will identify improvement opportunities and mitigate risks, while corrective actions will promptly address non-compliance and reinforce responsible practices across the supply chain.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Chief Compliance Officer will annually or as needed review the Sustainable Procurement Policy to assess compliance, identify improvements, and ensure alignment with regulations, industry standards, and ESG objectives. Updates will reflect review outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and best practices, with any significant changes communicated to employees, suppliers, and stakeholders to maintain transparency and clarity.
